name: Angler SF

menus.name: Cook For You tasting menu
menus.note: Shared courses chosen daily, always with the uni toast; for two or more, booked in advance with a $50 deposit, and required for parties of 8 to 11. No changes for dietary needs.

menus.name: Quick Catch lunch
menus.note: Oysters, half sea bream or half chicken with salad, then a sundae or sorbet; Tuesday to Saturday.

bookingOpens: Online on OpenTable. The Cook For You menu must be booked in advance, with a $50 a person deposit.
groups: Parties of 8 to 11 take the Cook For You menu; groups of 12 to 14 choose their menu ahead with a food and drink minimum. The Game Room takes up to 50, the Lounge up to 16, and the whole restaurant up to 74 seated or 200 standing.
byob: Corkage is $75 a bottle for the first two bottles and $150 for each one after that.
